queries:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT r.name AS name,
         SUM(res.points) AS total,
         AVG(CAST(res.laps AS NUMERIC)) AS avg_laps
  FROM results res
  JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY r.name
),
th AS (
  SELECT AVG(total) AS threshold FROM t
)
SELECT SUM(t.total) AS sum_total,
       AVG(t.avg_laps) AS avg_avg_laps,
       AVG(t.total - th.threshold) AS avg_diff
FROM t, th
WHERE t.total > th.threshold;
WITH t AS (
  SELECT r.name, COALESCE(SUM(res.points), 0) AS total
  FROM races r
  LEFT JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
  GROUP BY r.name
)
SELECT name FROM t WHERE total > (SELECT AVG(total) FROM t);
SELECT name, AVG(race_laps) AS average_laps
FROM (
  SELECT r.name AS name, r.raceId AS raceId, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS race_laps
  FROM races r
  JOIN results res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY r.name, r.raceId
)
GROUP BY name;
SELECT r.name, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL))
FROM results res
JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
GROUP BY r.name
HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;
SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN laps IS NOT NULL AND laps NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*' AND laps <> '' THEN CAST(laps AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END) FROM results;
